task.description:
Produce a design artefact for API-12 (Health endpoints) at src/design/api-health.md.

API-12 requires:
- Add unauthenticated GET /health/live endpoint returning HTTP 200 with {"status":"ok"} while process is running
- Add unauthenticated GET /health/ready endpoint returning HTTP 200 with {"status":"ok","db_latency_ms":N} only when DB connectivity and critical subsystems are operational
- Return HTTP 503 from /health/ready with structured failing-subsystem details when not ready
- /health/ready MUST call DB-04 (Pool.healthCheck) for connectivity verification
- Both endpoints must complete within 1 second
- Health requests must still participate in API-09 trace assignment

Design must include:
1. Proposed module/files for liveness and readiness handlers
2. Public types/functions for health response and failure detail payloads
3. Integration point in router while remaining unauthenticated
4. DB-04 call path and error mapping strategy (including pool exhausted case)
5. Subsystem readiness contract (what is checked now and extensibility for future checks)
6. Testability plan and acceptance-criteria traceability

Per backend developer guide section 6 format: include Module name, Zig source files, Public types, Public functions, Error types, and Integration notes.
acceptance_criteria: Defines explicit unauthenticated routing strategy for /health/live and /health/ready
Specifies DB-04 readiness probe integration and degraded 503 response shape
Defines module interfaces, public types, and error mapping for health endpoints
Documents <1s response-time strategy and trace propagation expectations
Includes integration notes for existing API modules

result.summary: Design artefact for API-12 health endpoints completed, including unauthenticated routing strategy, DB-04 readiness integration, degraded 503 payload shape, module interfaces, error mapping, trace propagation expectations, and testability/traceability plan.
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) for implementation and FRONTEND-DEV (Step 2b) for health endpoint consumption/docs alignment as needed
